description: This file defines a trait `LeavePermissionTrait` within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin, providing a method to check if a leave record is accessible based on user permissions. It includes logic for verifying if the current context has the necessary access rights, throwing exceptions otherwise.

methods.name: checkLeaveAccessible
methods.description: Checks if the given leave record is accessible to the current user, validating permissions and throwing an exception if access is denied.
